'''Kallik Kan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] residing on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time Question" /> when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kallik Kan appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Nar Shaddaa. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
